packages.title: Baseline, feature inventory, and reproducer
deliverables: Record branch, HEAD, toolchain, macOS, Xcode, SDK, filesystem types.
Map every path-sensitive call site in current source.
Add characterization tests for every filesystem tool and shell contract.
Add a deterministic final-leaf swap reproducer against the pre-fix implementation.

packages.title: Public API and volume capability probe
deliverables: Compile and run the macOS API probe.
Record flag values from public SDK headers.
Probe APFS and every supported qualification volume.
Define fail-closed errors for unsupported atomicity.
Measure strict versus leaf-only final-symlink rename behavior.
Persist a per-volume capability class and invalidate it on mount or OS change.

packages.title: Typed root capabilities and authorization boundary
deliverables: Persist project root identity and bookmark metadata.
Refactor internal authorization to carry typed capabilities.
Remove path strings as mutation authority.
Fence stale project generations.

packages.title: Darwin shim and descriptor primitives
deliverables: Add CForgeSecureFS target.
Implement RAII Swift descriptor types.
Implement strict component walker and hierarchy creator.
Add error and capability reporting.

packages.title: Read, list, glob, mkdir, write, and edit
deliverables: Descriptor-read with version token.
Descriptor list and in-process glob.
Race-safe mkdir hierarchy.
Staged atomic write and swap-based edit.
Remove Foundation and find-based authority from these paths.

packages.title: Atomic-capture delete
deliverables: Create same-volume private transaction namespace.
Make capture rename the linearization point.
Descriptor-recursive disposal.
Version conflict restore or quarantine.
Truthful cancellation and commit receipts.
Use a manager-reserved same-volume transaction root excluded from model-facing grants.

packages.title: Same-volume move
deliverables: Direct exclusive atomic move for current-entry contract.
Capture/verify/publish for exact-version contract.
Destination hierarchy and parent durability.
No precompare/rename window.

packages.title: Cross-volume move and descriptor copy
deliverables: Capture source before copy.
Replace /bin/cp with bounded descriptor copier.
Publish synchronized destination staging.
Recover every cross-volume state.
Define hard-link and metadata behavior.
Qualify fcopyfile on open descriptors for data, ACL, xattr, resource-fork, and metadata preservation.

packages.title: Immutable package ingestion
deliverables: Snapshot archive and directory inputs through descriptors.
Validate only managed immutable copies.
Harden extraction against path and normalization attacks.
Bind queue records to store hashes.

packages.title: Durable transaction repository and recovery worker
deliverables: Integrate transaction schema into control plane.
Persist intent before side effects.
Implement restart recovery and leases.
Implement bounded quarantine and reset interaction.

packages.title: Adversarial, compatibility, and resource qualification
deliverables: Run deterministic and stress race matrix.
Run serial/parallel SwiftPM and Xcode suites.
Prove shell preservation.
Prove memory, fd, transaction, and quarantine budgets.
Run attribution, secret, and source guards.
Run exact MCP tools/list and /bin/bash -lc shell smoke after restart and reset.
Run kill/restart recovery at every nonterminal transaction phase.

packages.title: Finding closure, documentation, and pull request
deliverables: Update finding with complete evidence.
Update architecture and operator documentation.
Create focused mergeable PR against current main.
Run final doctor and state selector.

autonomy_policy.recoverable_failure: persist evidence, apply bounded retry or compensation, then continue with the next unblocked action
autonomy_policy.missing_native_environment: record deferred_environment_release_blocker, continue host-independent work, and never mark the native gate passed
autonomy_policy.source_divergence: adapt to the current descendant without reverting later fixes
autonomy_policy.data_safety: prefer restore or quarantine over destructive cleanup when state is ambiguous

security_decision.forbidden: validate a pathname entry and later destroy or rename that same pathname based on the earlier observation
